name: comp-510
title: Pricing Calendar
blurb: Calendar showing prices under each date with color-coded bargain indicators.
description: Two-month calendar overlaying prices on each day. Good prices (under $100) are highlighted in emerald green. Custom DayButton component renders date + price. Dates without pricing data are disabled.
use_when: Flight or hotel bookings where users need to see pricing across dates and identify bargains at a glance.
avoid_when: When prices exceed a few characters — they'll overflow the small button space.
a11y: Calendar is keyboard-accessible. Prices are inline text, readable by screen readers.
